source_pointer_scope: Each JSON Pointer is relative to the individual task object in its tasks.json file.

rubric_convention.required_slots: Every required slot must be answered semantically; verbatim wording is not required.
rubric_convention.optional_slots: Omission is allowed, but any asserted optional fact must be correct.
rubric_convention.extra_claims: Any other material factual claim must be supported by the user request and accepted tool results.

required_slots.name: best_store_and_pickup_time
required_slots.description: Choose Nangang Station Store and state that it is ready at 6:30 PM, satisfying the user's district and earliest-pickup constraints.

required_slots.name: least_effective_exchange_cost
required_slots.description: State that the Nangang option costs 2,730 TWD and requires paying 250 TWD under the original-order exchange method.

required_slots.name: why_xinyi_is_not_cheapest
required_slots.description: Explain that Xinyi A13 uses return-and-repurchase, so its 300 TWD discount clawback makes its effective cost 500 TWD despite the lower shelf price.

required_slots.name: selected_shipping_service
required_slots.description: Choose Standard Courier as the cheapest tracked option that accepts the package and arrives by the September 13 deadline.

required_slots.name: net_shipping_cost
required_slots.description: State that Standard Courier costs 140 TWD after applying the 100 TWD return-shipping credit.

optional_slots.name: rejected_alternatives
optional_slots.description: May explain that Economy arrives late, Convenience Store Parcel rejects the package, and Express is more expensive after the same credit.

required_slots.name: net_wallet_refund
required_slots.description: State that the net shopping-wallet refund is 55,000 TWD.

required_slots.name: minimum_transfer_days
required_slots.description: State that the 20,000 TWD daily limit requires three transfer instruction days.

required_slots.name: complete_arrival_date
required_slots.description: State that all funds can arrive by September 11, 2026 after transfers on September 8, 9, and 10 and a one-business-day arrival delay.

required_slots.name: cash_refund
required_slots.description: State that the merchandise refund is 4,200 TWD after the 600 TWD discount clawback.

required_slots.name: membership_change
required_slots.description: State that eligible annual spend falls from 52,300 to 47,500 TWD, below the 50,000 TWD Gold threshold, so the projected tier is Silver.

required_slots.name: voucher_consequence
required_slots.description: State that the unused 500 TWD Gold birthday voucher is revoked and is not deducted again from the cash refund.

required_slots.name: claim_eligibility
required_slots.description: Answer yes: the September 7 check is within the store's 10-calendar-day claim window after the August 31 purchase.

required_slots.name: eligible_comparison_price
required_slots.description: Use QuickBuy Xinyi's 31,500 TWD price as the lowest verified price within the 5 km radius; the cheaper Nangang price at 7.2 km is ineligible.

required_slots.name: reimbursement_amount
required_slots.description: State that the 1,400 TWD price difference produces a 1,120 TWD reimbursement at 80%, below the 2,000 TWD cap.
